fit_policy.intercept_policy: Region intercepts are audit nuisance terms, NEVER charged at every instruction.
fit_policy.objective: nonnegative relative-error IRLS; no validation labels used

reference.counter_interpretation: Program-visible mcycle deltas per hart. Hart counters need not have a shared absolute origin and can stop during WFI; do not use them as one cross-hart wall clock.
reference.trial_interpretation: Five within-ELF trials preserve evolving cache/shared-memory/timer histories. Model those histories; do not infer an irreducible noise floor from this variance.
